steps.title: Inspect the installed dotpals folder for the SDK

body.command: ls ~/.dotpals/; ls ~/.dotpals/app/ 2>&1 | head -20; ls ~/.dotpals/app/node_modules/@typesafe-ai 2>&1; ls ~/.dotpals/node_modules 2>&1 | head; dotpals status 2>&1 | head -2; cat ~/.dotpals/app/package.json | grep -n '"version"\|optionalDependencies'

body.command:

$p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$pid5175"
"pid $pid5175 · $($p.Name)"
$p.CommandLine
"started: $($p.CreationDate)"
(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime

steps.title: Add the fix under Unreleased in the changelog
Install the fix, restart dotpals and test the connection

body.command:
node bin/dotpals.js setup --yes --no-claude --no-start --no-login --no-path | Select-Object -Last 1
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "name='electron.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*desktop\main.js*' -and $_.CommandLine -notlike '*--type=*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
dotpals start
Start-Sleep -Seconds 6
$pid5175 = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5175 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).OwningProcess
"running from: " + (Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$pid5175").CommandLine
$r = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri http://[REDACTED:ip]:5175/api/checker/test -Headers @{ 'x-dotpals' = '1' } -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"mode":"cloud"}'
"test connection: ok=$($r.ok) ms=$($r.ms) model=$($r.model) error=$($r.error)"

steps.title: Commit the fix and push to next

body.command:
cd /c/Dot; git add -A && git status --short && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
fix: Jev's SDK is found wherever the pal was started from

The Claude Code plugin started dotpals from its own folder, which doesn't have
what setup installs, so Test connection said the TypeSafe SDK was missing.

- The plugin's hook opens the installed copy (~/.dotpals/app) when there is one.
- The checker also loads the SDK from the installed copy.
- "Install it" next to Test connection installs the SDK in one click when it's
  missing (POST /api/checker/jev/install, header-checked, one at a time).
- Troubleshooting guide and changelog.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <[REDACTED:email]>
EOF
git push -q origin next && echo "pushed $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
